column1: # Activation cases for the kernel catalog.
# Format:  <expected skill> TAB <the sentence you would use to ask for the job>
# The rule they check: a sentence WITHOUT proper names has to activate the
# kernel's procedure, never a project's adapter. If an adapter wins, in the
# other projects it is winning something that does not apply.
# The sentences are written the way the job is really asked for, with their
# register and their imprecision, not in the vocabulary of the description. A
# sentence copied from the description always passes and proves nothing.
